We propose a transformer-based encoder for point cloud understanding. The encoder combines local geometric features with global contextual information.

Our evaluation covers three tasks: classification, segmentation, and registration. The point cloud encoder is trained from scratch on each dataset.

We compare the proposed method with several baselines including PointNet and DGCNN. The results show that the encoder achieves competitive accuracy and precision.

All experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA GPU. We release the code and pretrained weights to facilitate future research.
